We present a new Monte Carlo event generator for the production of four fermions in electron-positiron collisions.
the program is fully functional and can be used for all the four-fermion processes, including Higgs and W + W − production and decay, with full massive kinematics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a fully massive, fast, accurate and flexible tool for fourfermion production.
we provide the first, fully massive, implementation of four-fermion processes with all possible final states, which includes all the relevant higher order corrections.
the new code is a reliable, efficient and fast tool for the simulation of e + e − fourfermion production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the program is fast and can be easily interfaced with existing Monte Carlo generators, allowing for the first time a realistic description of four-fermion processes at the ILC.
, for the most important channels, the accuracy of the results is at the 0.2–0.5% level.
, in spite of the complexity of the processes, it is possible to compute them in a fast and accurate way.
